ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark gray) to high-intensity (white) pixels. Low-intensity pixels dominate the medial region, while high-intensity pixels are concentrated in the lateral distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity (white) contiguous blobs located on the lateral-most 25% of each lobe. The central 50% of the surface area is a solid low-intensity black mass. Distinct high-frequency mottling and stippling occur at the interface between the white and black regions on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 15 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the central fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by irregular triangular peaks and rounded valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the distal-lateral boundaries leading to sharply tapered, upwardly-angled tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast, raised pixel nodules (barnacles) located on the distal-most tips and outer margins of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark, non-linear pixel disruptions visible within the high-intensity white region of the left lobe, primarily oriented on a diagonal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; significant irregular serration/erosion of the trailing edge boundary.
